decision_basis.D19: A: bundled necessary Ctags/SCM helpers confirmed
decision_basis.D02: local+LAN; approximately 5 simultaneous people; no role/project ACL management

timing_contract.overlap_policy: retain spans and critical path; do not sum overlapping stages

reporting_rules: Keep query type/project/cache/index activity groups separate.
Retain every failure and unfinished request.
Report speed ratios only for feature-and-result-equivalent groups.
No performance pass without approved SLO and run evidence.
notes: All nulls are intentionally unmeasured/unconfirmed, not zero.
This template defines no new test IDs.
User approval of bundled helpers is not permission for automatic network downloads or source synchronization.
Five people is not 5 QPS or a hard limit of 5 concurrent HTTP requests.
No role/project ACL requirement. Anonymous reader access is proposed, not additional user-confirmed authentication policy. Management exposure awaits D16.
Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 is confirmed. Record the actual point release/image during tests; Apple M1 arm64 is confirmed, while the actual/minimum macOS version remains unspecified.
Mac PASS cannot substitute for Linux native results. Compare oracle and candidate on the same host within each platform; do not attribute cross-host differences to Rust.
Record native arm64 execution separately from Rosetta x86_64; translated runs cannot count as native M1 acceptance.
